text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: Well now, that's rare to see.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon me. 
For showing you such an unsightly daze.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, 
I was reviewing race footage, you see...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As I watched, my blood began to boil with 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A battlefield where one wagers all they 
possess. 
The final straight, locked in fierce 
contention—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even recalling it sent shivers down my 
spine, 
and I simply could not sit still...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Meditation availed me not, 
nor could I sleep upon lying down... and 
thus, here I am...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Phalaenopsis didn't 
get much rest at all.
